metadata.title: Sovereign, city and regional heat risk finance
metadata.disclaimer: Listing is not endorsement and is not financial, insurance or investment advice.
metadata.scope: Targeted global evidence map prioritising South/Southeast Asia.41 records include operating funds, product frameworks, historical non-heat direct models, proposals and a municipal procurement. Not 41 issued heat policies or an exhaustive legal census.
metadata.method: Current primary legal, lender, insurer, government and evaluation documents searched and relevant sections retrieved. Access and review limitations retained. Older laws are background and current operational amendments separately qualified.
metadata.schema: Requested top-level shape retained. Additional keys distinguish scope, administrative eligibility, financial stage, source review depth, funding pathways and verification gaps.
metadata.heat_codes: yes=explicit statutory/product/project heat scope, conditional on stated rules; partly=broad conditional eligibility or development pipeline, NOT verified automatic heat cover; no=no heat peril in reviewed specified product scope, included as direct design model; unclear=insufficient current legal/product evidence.
metadata.payment_rules: Treasury/institutional receipts are not household benefits. People affected are not people paid. No verified heat drawdown is not a claim of never triggered.
metadata.money_rules: No aggregate across budgets, credit, limits, premiums and payments. Multi-year/all-hazard envelopes are not heat allocations. For 2026 INR values the 2025 annual rate is an explicit reference; PHP2026 usesSeptember2026 BSP monthly average; these are not transaction FX.
metadata.source_rules: Working content and review depth are distinguished. Some current-term gaps have official index evidence only and are not represented as verified operational clauses. Pre2018 original laws are background even where legally relevant. Official index-only or inaccessible full-text records remain bounded and must not be used as verified current spending rules.
metadata.quality_status: Local structural and FX arithmetic validation passed; unknown operational details are not thereby verified.

instruments.name: Regional sovereign risk pool
instruments.plain_definition: Governments purchase defined catastrophe cover through a shared facility.
instruments.how_it_breaks_the_cycle: Possible design pathway: protect planned spending from emergency reallocations and provide predictable residual-risk funding. Outcomes depend on reliable replenishment, authorisation and delivery.
instruments.risk_holder: Contracted risk with insurer/investors; uncovered risk remains public.
instruments.who_pays: Government or premium-support partner, according to contract.
instruments.who_receives: Government/city/implementer first; people benefit through separately specified transfers or services.
instruments.speed: Operation-specific; institutional settlement and final-recipient receipt must be timed separately.
instruments.typical_cost: No defensible universal cost verified. Budget opportunity/replenishment cost; credit fees/debt service; insurance premium, data and administration depend on contract.
instruments.strengths: Pre-arrangement can clarify who finances which costs and when.
instruments.limits: Legal availability alone does not ensure spending authority or last-mile access.
instruments.basis_risk: Peril/index mismatch can separate payout from observed harm.
instruments.reaches_poorest_why: Requires a funded service/benefit and inclusion route; no general household entitlement inferred.
